{{Quote|This is a surprise. Have you come all the way from Coruscant just to shop for prisht fruits?''"<br />"''It is said that Barlok horticultural techniques produce the best specimens.|Jorus C'baoth to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Outbound">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>}}
'''Prisht fruit''' was a sweet [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that could be used to make [[Prisht-fruit salad|salads]]. [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]] was known for growing fine prisht and it was the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] most prized produce.<ref name="Outbound" />
